title: UsageMeasurement
description: A recorded usage measurement for a metered feature associated with a Stigg customer.

id.description: Unique identifier of the usage measurement.

customerId.description: The customer ID for which usage was reported.

featureId.description: The feature ID for which usage was reported.

updateBehavior.description: Whether the value was a delta increment (DELTA) or an absolute set (SET).

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key used to prevent duplicate reporting.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the usage measurement.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the measurement was recorded.
